mapper.select: WITH candidate AS ( SELECT lambda_assignment_id, lane, run_id, invocation_gen FROM lambda_invoke_retry_outbox WHERE retry_at <= #{now} AND (claim_until IS NULL OR claim_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY retry_at, lambda_assignment_id, lane, run_id, invocation_gen LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE lambda_invoke_retry_outbox o SET claim_id = #{claimId,typeHandler=dev.olegz.vf.registry.dao.handlers.UuidStringTypeHandler}, claim_until = #{claimUntil} FROM candidate c WHERE o.lambda_assignment_id = c.lambda_assignment_id AND o.lane = c.lane AND o.run_id = c.run_id AND o.invocation_gen = c.invocation_gen RETURNING o.lambda_assignment_id, o.lane, o.run_id, o.invocation_gen, o.payload, o.retry_at, CAST(o.claim_id AS VARCHAR) AS claim_id, o.claim_until
